paper.title_en: Probing the Kinematic Dipole with LISA: an analytical treatment
paper.abstract_en: The motion of the Solar System with respect to the cosmic rest frame induces a kinematic dipole in the stochastic gravitational-wave background (GWB). Detecting this signal with space-based interferometers would provide an independent measurement of our peculiar velocity and a GW probe of cosmic anisotropies. We present a fully analytic derivation of the response of the \emph{Laser Interferometer Space Antenna} (LISA) to a kinematic dipole, and construct an optimal estimator for its detection. We show that the dipolar response is governed by a single frequency-dependent function fixed by symmetry, and we compute its behaviour across the LISA band. Using Fisher forecasts, we find that for a scale-invariant background detectability requires $h^2Ω_{\rm GW} \gtrsim 5\times 10^{-8}$ for \emph{fiducial} LISA, and $h^2Ω_{\rm GW} \gtrsim 5\times 10^{-10}$ for a detector with characteristic instrumental-noise amplitudes improved by an order of magnitude. Prospects are more favorable for signals with richer frequency profile. We also explore the potential of the kinematic dipole to break degeneracies, particularly in the presence of strong galactic foregrounds or noise features that closely mimic the primordial signal.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文对 LISA 对随机引力波背景中运动学偶极的响应给出了完全解析的推导，构造了最优估计量，并通过 Fisher 预报量化了可探测性，同时讨论了简并破除与前景噪声的影响。理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强，主题与随机引力波背景（PTA）及引力理论基础密切相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 用 LISA 探测运动学偶极：一种解析处理
decision.abstract_zh: 太阳系相对于宇宙静止参考系的运动会在随机引力波背景（GWB）中诱导出运动学偶极。用空间干涉仪探测这一信号将提供对本地本动速度的独立测量，以及对宇宙各向异性的引力波探针。我们给出了\emph{激光干涉空间天线}（LISA）对运动学偶极响应的完全解析推导，并构造了用于其探测的最优估计量。我们表明，偶极响应由对称性所固定的单一频率依赖函数决定，并计算了其在 LISA 频段内的行为。利用 Fisher 预报，我们发现对于标度不变的背景，探测能力要求 \emph{基准} LISA 达到 $h^2\Omega_{\rm GW} \gtrsim 5\times 10^{-8}$，而对于特征仪器噪声幅度改善一个数量级的探测器则要求 $h^2\Omega_{\rm GW} \gtrsim 5\times 10^{-10}$。对于频率剖面更丰富的信号，前景更为有利。我们还探索了运动学偶极在破除简并方面的潜力，特别是在存在强星系前景或与 primordial 信号极为相似的噪声特征时。
